mintAuthority.summary: EURR issuance is controlled through StablR signer/admin infrastructure with a 1-of-3 owner safe. StablR can mint or pause supply subject to its EMI reserve and redemption obligations.

mintIncidents.summary: A compromised StablR mint/governance key let the attacker mint 4.5M unbacked EURR as part of a coordinated USDR/EURR attack, leaving both tokens undercollateralized and forcing mint/redeem suspension.

review.evidence: Ethereum (2026-05-25): owner 0x05Aa2D11B1 as 2/2 multisig, proxy admin 0xA0609c2F as 1/1 multisig. Solana SPL mint (2026-06-11): mintAuthority and freezeAuthority are non-executable system-program-owned wallet accounts (issuer-backend). All addressable mint-capable surfaces confirmed. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled Ethereum and Solana mint paths are unbounded, Grant Thornton quarterly proof of reserve provides periodic reconciliation, and MFSA EMI authorization is prudential supervision.
